task.claim:
Let v_1, ..., v_k be vectors in Z^2 and L their Z-span. Let d be the gcd of all
2x2 minors det[v_i v_j], i < j (the quantity `element_index` computes). If
d != 0 then [Z^2 : L] = d: there is a map rep : Z^2 -> {0, ..., d-1}, onto,
with rep(v) = rep(w) if and only if v - w lies in L.
